doc.name: Ainovaq
doc.instructions: Read-only tools for Ainovaq, the AI venture studio: list_services and get_service_details explain the five services, search_blog finds articles, get_contact_info gives contact and booking details. Booking itself is done by the user at the book_a_call URL.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List Ainovaq services
tools.description: List the five services Ainovaq offers (Build, GTM, Digital, Talent, Infra) with a one-line summary and page URL for each.

tools.name: get_service_details
tools.title: Get service details
tools.description: Get what one Ainovaq service includes, its type and its page URL.

service.description: Which service: build, gtm, digital, talent or infra.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.title: Search the Ainovaq blog
tools.description: Search Ainovaq blog articles (startups, go-to-market, B2B marketing, sales, hiring, SaaS and AI development). Returns titles, short summaries and links.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "MVP timeline" or "B2B marketing".

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact details
tools.description: Get Ainovaq contact details: email, phone, LinkedIn and the page to book a free consultation.
